newsitem.title: USA: CNN says Jewell settlement amicable.
newsitem.headline: CNN says Jewell settlement amicable.

text.p: Time Warner Inc's Cable News Network said on Tuesday it reached an amicable settlement with Richard Jewell and his mother, Barbara, over the cable news channel's coverage of the Centennial Olympic Park bombing.
But a CNN spokesman said he could not disclose the financial component of the agreement.
"CNN continues to believe that its coverage was a fair and accurate review of the events that unfolded following the Centennial Olympic Park Explosion," CNN said in a statement.

"The Jewells, while not agreeing to the fairness and accuracy of all portions of CNN's coverage, understand CNN's efforts to cover events such as the Centennial Olympic Park explosion," the statement continued.
